title: Adjournment Motion on marriage and parenthood support
what_it_is: An Adjournment Motion speech by Ms Elysa Chen on marriage and parenthood, followed by a response from Second Minister for National Development Ms Indranee Rajah.
why_it_matters: The record sets out proposals on leave, childcare, work, fertility and housing, and a Government update that the Marriage and Parenthood Reset Workgroup is developing a long-term roadmap. Ms Indranee Rajah said the Workgroup will study Ms Chen's suggestions and continue engagements. No immediate policy changes are stated in the transcript.

key_points.point: Ms Elysa Chen called for an increase in the statutory minimum annual leave under the Employment Act.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: now is the time to increase the minimum annual leave

key_points.point: She proposed allowing employees to use their own sick leave based on their dependants' Medical Certificates.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: I propose that the Government consider allowing employees to utilise their own sick leave based on the Medical Certificates of their dependants

key_points.point: She proposed increasing Government-paid childcare leave.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: Additionally, we should increase Government-paid childcare leave.

key_points.point: She asked the Prime Minister's Office for an update on the review of leave policies.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: Will the Prime Minister's Office (PMO) to give an update on the review of the leave policies?

key_points.point: She said basic childcare subsidies should be universal for all children regardless of the mother's employment status.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: Such basic subsidies should be universal for all children, regardless of the mother's employment status.

key_points.point: She proposed a limited subsidy for underutilised childcare operators to fund shuttle services.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: we could provide a limited subsidy to such underutilised operators to fund shuttle services

key_points.point: She proposed extending site tender access to all operators, including mid-tier operators.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: the Government extends site tender access to all operators, including mid-tier operators

key_points.point: She asked for preliminary observations from the infant childminding pilot.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: what are the preliminary observations from the pilot

key_points.point: She proposed comprehensive home visitation postpartum support.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: I propose comprehensive home visitation postpartum support.

key_points.point: She proposed that structured in-home postpartum visits deliberately engage fathers.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: I therefore propose that the structured in-home postpartum visits deliberately engage fathers

key_points.point: She proposed a transport care credit scheme.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: I propose a transport care credit scheme.

key_points.point: She proposed extending maternity leave up to six months fully Government-paid up to a salary cap, with an optional additional six months at half-pay, also Government-funded up to a cap.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: I propose extending maternity leave up to six months, fully Government-paid up to a salary cap, with an optional additional six months at half-pay, also Government-funded up to a cap.

key_points.point: She asked whether the Government would consider a mechanism to alleviate cashflow issues for employers.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: Will the Government consider a mechanism that could alleviate such cashflow issues for employers?

key_points.point: She proposed a Career Comeback Tax Credit for employers who hire returning stay-at-home parents.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: I propose we introduce a Career Comeback Tax Credit for employers who hire returning stay-at-home parents.

key_points.point: She proposed a "Make It Work" grant for building owners to install lockable lactation pods.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: I suggest we introduce a "Make It Work" grant for building owners to install self-contained, lockable lactation pods

key_points.point: She proposed that the Government consider partially subsidising elective egg freezing or allowing MediSave to be used for it.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: the Government should consider partially subsidising elective egg freezing (EEF) or allowing MediSave to be used for it.

key_points.point: She proposed allowing large families or two-family units to apply for side-by-side 3-room or 4-room BTO units with the option to knock down the dividing wall.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: I propose allowing large families or two-family units, comprising elderly parents and couples with children, to apply for "side-by-side" 3-room or 4-room BTO units, with the structural option to knock down the dividing wall.

key_points.point: She proposed a Second Child Priority Scheme for 5-room BTOs and Sales of Balance Flats.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: We should have a "Second Child Priority Scheme" also for 5-room BTOs and Sales of Balance Flats.

key_points.point: She proposed a Family Expansion Grant targeted at the HDB resale market.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: I also propose a Family Expansion Grant targeted at the HDB resale market.

key_points.point: Ms Indranee Rajah said the Marriage and Parenthood Reset Workgroup is developing a long-term roadmap.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: we are developing a long-term roadmap to strengthen support for marriage and parenthood

key_points.point: She said recently released marriage and parenthood statistics have sharpened urgency to act.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: Recently released statistics on marriage and parenthood have also sharpened our urgency to act.

key_points.point: She said there were about 24,700 registered marriages last year, a 6.2% drop from 2024.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: Last year, there were about 24,700 registered marriages, a 6.2% drop from 2024.

key_points.point: She said Singapore recorded about 26,100 citizen births in 2025, a 10.8% decrease from 29,200 in 2024.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: Singapore recorded about 26,100 citizen births in 2025, a 10.8% decrease from 29,200 in 2024.

key_points.point: She said working parents now have a total of 30 weeks of paid parental leave.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: working parents now have a total of 30 weeks of paid parental leave to care for and bond with their infants.

key_points.point: She said the Government is engaging tripartite partners on providing more protected time for working parents.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: We are engaging tripartite partners on this.

key_points.point: She said the Tripartite Guidelines on FWA Requests were implemented in December 2024.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: We implemented the Tripartite Guidelines on FWA Requests in December 2024

key_points.point: She said employers can tap the Productivity Solutions Grant and SkillsFuture Workforce Development Grant (Job Redesign+).
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: employers can tap on the Productivity Solutions Grant to offset the costs of adopting FWAs and the SkillsFuture Workforce Development Grant (Job Redesign+) to engage consultancy services to support enterprise job redesign.

key_points.point: She said multi-generation families may apply for 3Gen flats.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: multi-generation families may apply for 3Gen flats

key_points.point: She said flat owners may apply to combine two adjoining 3-room or smaller flats under the Conversion of Adjoining Flats Scheme.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: Flat owners may also apply to combine two adjoining 3-room or smaller flats under the Conversion of Adjoining Flats Scheme.

key_points.point: She said the Third Child Priority Scheme was recently enhanced.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: We also recently enhanced the Third Child Priority Scheme

key_points.point: She said the Workgroup will review financing support for elective egg freezing and consider ways to reduce the cost of fertility tests and treatments.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: The Workgroup will review the Member's suggestion to provide financing support for EEF and consider ways to reduce the cost of fertility tests and treatments.

key_points.point: She said full-day infant care places nearly tripled and full-day childcare places nearly doubled over the past decade.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: the number of full-day infant care places has nearly tripled while the number of full-day childcare places nearly doubled.

key_points.point: She said the industry median childcare fee before means-tested subsidies fell to $680 last year, compared to $760 in 2021.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: The industry median childcare fee before means-tested subsidies has fallen to $680 last year, compared to $760 in 2021.

key_points.point: She said the infant childminding pilot concludes next year.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: The pilot concludes next year.

key_points.point: She said support for marriage and parenthood must be a whole-of-society effort.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: support for marriage and parenthood must be a whole-of-society effort.

key_points.point: She said the Workgroup will continue to engage widely across society in the coming months.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: In the coming months, we will continue to engage widely across society, with Singaporeans, businesses and community partners.

key_points.point: Ms Elysa Chen corrected her earlier statement, saying she meant 14 days, not 14 years.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen
key_points.quote: I meant to say 14 days.

what_happens_next: Ms Indranee Rajah said the Workgroup will continue to engage widely across society in the coming months and will study the recommendations closely. The transcript records that Parliament adjourned accordingly at 9.30 pm.
